Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Ecommerce Specialist position. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your ecommerce growth across Website, App, and Zalando.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I use Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEMrush to monitor performance and provide actionable insights. My hands-on experience with CMS tools and analytics aligns well with your requirements.

I am passionate about ecommerce and customer experience, and I am eager to apply my skills to support daily operations, promotions, and campaign optimization. I am proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I am currently improving my Dutch (B1). I am also available to start immediately.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content · Ecommerce
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content management. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data and technical SEO audits to improve visibility. Comfortable across content management, analytics, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into ecommerce content management and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & Content (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage) and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across search engines
- Ran iterative technical SEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)
